evidence.quote: Reproduces the missing-id failure pattern from prod

observations.why: Flat assertive statement of what the test does — no hedges, no ratification language, no operational rule; a confident claim still being stated, not settled.

evidence.quote: Must not crash; must produce a valid slug.

observations.why: Operational rule with modal 'must' stated twice — a load-bearing requirement the speaker expects to be met, performing the settling of a constraint rather than arguing for it.
